pr_title: feat(workflow): scaffold core workflowVersion entity + trigger cache (phase 0)

comments.body: `computeCronPatternFromSchedule(trigger)` throws a `WorkflowTriggerException` when a CUSTOM cron pattern is invalid. See `modules/workflow/workflow-trigger/utils/compute-cron-pattern-from-schedule.ts:10-21` and `:29`. This util is called inside the `for` loop in `workspace-workflow-automated-trigger-map-cache.service.ts:248-255`, with no try/catch. If one ACTIVE version in a workspace has a bad cron pattern, `computeForCache` rejects. Then the whole `workflowAutomatedTriggerMaps` cache fails for that workspace, and every other valid CRON and DATABASE_EVENT trigger in it goes with it. The loop should catch the error per version and skip that version.
